newsitem.title: USA: US spot jet prices gain on diffs, NYMEX strength.
newsitem.headline: US spot jet prices gain on diffs, NYMEX strength.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel prices strengthened Friday as both the differentials and NYMEX futures ended the day on a bullish note.
U.S. Gulf 54-grade barrels for the back 3rd cycle on the Colonial Pipeline were offered at about 1.0 cent under the screen, firming about 0.25 cent from Thursday in thin trade.
Market watchers said mojor players who bid diffs up earlier in the week kept prices supported on Friday.
New York Harbor prompt 54-grade barrels were talked between 2.75 and 3.00 cents under, up 0.5 cent on the day.
-- Matt Daily, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1626
